description: This Java class 'PackingSessionLine' models a line item in a shipment packing session within the Apache OFBiz framework. It contains attributes related to order details, product information, dimensions, quantities, and methods to issue items to shipments, update picklist items, and assign items to packages.

classes.name: PackingSessionLine
classes.description: Represents a line in a shipment packing session, encapsulating product details, quantities, dimensions, and methods for managing shipment and packaging operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: issueItemToShipment
methods.description: Issues the item to a shipment, updates the shipment item sequence, and optionally updates the picklist item status based on the bin ID.

methods.name: applyLineToPackage
methods.description: Associates the line item with a shipment package, adding its content to the package in the shipment process.

methods.name: isSameItem
methods.description: Determines if another line represents the same inventory item within the same order and shipment group.

methods.name: getOrderId
methods.description: Returns the order ID associated with this line.

methods.name: getOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the order item sequence ID.

methods.name: getShipGroupSeqId
methods.description: Returns the shipment group sequence ID.

methods.name: getInventoryItemId
methods.description: Returns the inventory item ID.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the product ID.

methods.name: getShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: setShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of items.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of items.

methods.name: addQuantity
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity to the current quantity.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight.

methods.name: setWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight.

methods.name: addWeight
methods.description: Adds a specified weight to the current weight.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length dimension.

methods.name: setLength
methods.description: Sets the length dimension.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width dimension.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width dimension.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height dimension.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height dimension.

methods.name: getShipmentBoxTypeId
methods.description: Returns the shipment box type ID.

methods.name: setShipmentBoxTypeId
methods.description: Sets the shipment box type ID.

methods.name: getWeightPackageSeqId
methods.description: Returns the weight package sequence ID.

methods.name: setWeightPackageSeqId
methods.description: Sets the weight package sequence ID.

methods.name: getPackageSeq
methods.description: Returns the package sequence number.
